description: Regional Economy & Trade Brief — Given a US state, county or metro (name, FIPS or CBSA), an industry (NAICS code or description) and a role (retailer, logistics, cfo, lender, other), reads BLS LAUS and QCEW, FRED (state employment, house prices, goods exports and imports, regional CPI), Census Building Permits and USAspending live, then computes levels, year-over-year and three-year changes, location quotient, z-scores against th

industry.description: NAICS code (44-45, 722, 4841) or a plain description ("restaurants", "trucking").

lookbackYears.description: Years of history used for z-scores (default 5).

region.description: A US state, county or metropolitan area by name ("Ohio", "Travis County, TX", "Phoenix metro"), state FIPS (39), county FIPS (48453) or metro CBSA code (38060).

regionType.description: Disambiguates a name that is both a county and a metro or state.

name: regional-economy-brief
